description: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of token routing, specifically showing the proportions allocated to different routing methods. The chart contains three slices representing categories: LOCAL, EDGE_P2P, and LLM. The largest slice, labeled “LOCAL”, is green and occupies approximately 94.5% of the chart. “EDGE_P2P” is a blue slice representing 1.6% of the total, while “LLM” is a red slice accounting for 3.9%. Percentage labels are displayed inside each slice. A legend is present, labeling each color with its corresponding routing method. The slices are arranged in a clockwise order, with the largest slice positioned at the top and the remaining slices following in descending order of size.
